takes.title: The Read-Through
takes.twist_text: Take one. Nobody is judging yet: find the net twice.

takes.title: The Big Room
takes.twist_text: We moved to the big stage. More ice, and the clock is rolling.

takes.title: Rough Cut
takes.twist_text: Drop the manners. Hit them, but keep the puck in frame.

takes.title: Set Pieces
takes.twist_text: The art department dressed the set. Play around the props, or off them.

takes.title: Second Wind
takes.twist_text: Rubber boards, and every goal gives your crew a second wind. Bank it in.

takes.title: The Last Word
takes.twist_text: The last goal is the one they remember. Make it yours.

takes.title: Slow Motion
takes.twist_text: Widescreen. The far net is a long way off: take the fast way round.

takes.title: The Final Cut
takes.twist_text: Final cut against the best cast: hits allowed, and the set may close in.
